header.title: Connect your LMS
header.subtitle: Add the learning systems your institute uses — you can connect more than one (e.g. a LearnDash site and a Moodle site). Apply a connection to a specific course from that course's Settings tab.

banner.courseSourceInfo: We found an LMS connection already configured on one of your courses and listed it below. Review it and click <1>Save</1> to keep it as an institute connection.

emptyState.title: No external LMS connected
emptyState.description: Your learners use the built-in Vacademy LMS. Connect a LearnDash or Moodle site below to sync enrolments to it.

connectionName.label: Connection name
connectionName.hint: A label to recognise this connection when you apply it to a course.

customFields.label: Custom fields (optional)
customFields.hint: Add any other connection details your LMS needs as key–value pairs.

validation.invalidUrl: Must start with http:// or https://

testResult.genericFailure: Could not run the test. Try again.

confirmSaveDialog.title: Save LMS connection changes?
confirmSaveDialog.description: Changes to an <1>existing</1> connection (URL, credentials, token) apply to every course already using it — so an incorrect edit can break enrolment sync for those courses. New connections won't affect anything until you apply them to a course. Double-check before saving.
